title: Segmentation basics
objectives: Distinguish between paging and segmentation memory schemes
Explain how a logical address is split into segment and offset under segmentation

blocks.text: Segmentation divides memory into variable-sized segments, each with its own base and limit register. A logical address consists of a segment number and an offset within that segment. The hardware uses the segment number to look up the base address and limit, checking that the offset does not exceed the limit before computing the physical address.
